content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: India Exim Bank has announced 120 vacancies for Management Trainee and Manager positions. The recruitment includes 90 Management Trainee vacancies and 30 Manager vacancies. The post-wise details are provided below: By category, the 90 Management Trainee posts are UR 40, SC 07, ST 09, OBC (NCL) 25 and EWS 9 (including 03 PwBD). The 30 Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) posts are UR 15, SC 03, ST 02, OBC (NCL) 07 and EWS 03 (including 01 PwBD).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Note: Candidates should verify the prescribed qualification, minimum marks, experience and other eligibility conditions before submitting an application. Candidates appearing in their final qualifying examinations by May 2027 may also take the written examination. Post-graduation done through online / correspondence / part-time / distance mode is not accepted.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Management Trainee: The previous recruitment eligibility range was 21 to 28 years. The age limit for the 2026 recruitment is subject to confirmation in the detailed notification. The detailed notification confirms it as not below 21 and not above 28 years as on 01 November 2026. Manager: The minimum and maximum age limits will be specified in the detailed notification. The detailed notification sets it at not below 24 and not above 30 years as on 01 November 2026. Age Relaxation: Applicable category-wise relaxation will be governed by the official recruitment rules. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (NCL). For PwBD it is relaxed by 10 years (General/EWS), 13 years (OBC-NCL) and 15 years (SC/ST), and Ex-servicemen get up to 5 years. The age calculation cutoff date and applicable relaxations should be verified from the detailed Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 notification.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee
content_sections.text: General / OBC Candidates: Rs. 600/- (Application fee and intimation charges) SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female Candidates: Rs. 100/- (Intimation charges only) Payment Mode: As specified in the official application instructions. Payment is online only (Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards / Mobile Wallets) from 27-11-2026 to 11-12-2026. The category-wise application fee for this recruitment has not been confirmed in the short notice. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification before making any payment. The detailed notification now confirms the fee shown above, and fees once paid are non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Management Trainee: Rs. 65,000/- monthly stipend during the one-year training. After training they are absorbed as Deputy Manager (JM-I) in the pay scale Rs. 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920 (CTC about Rs. 25 lakh a year). Manager (MM-II): Rs. 64820-2340-67160-2680-93960 (CTC about Rs. 30 lakh a year).

content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a Written Test and a Personal Interview. The written test is a subjective Professional Knowledge paper of 100 marks lasting 2 hours 30 minutes. Part I is a compulsory question or case study (40 marks) and in Part II candidates attempt any 6 of 8 questions (60 marks), all based on the selected specialization. The final selection is based on 70% weightage for the written test and 30% for the interview. The exam will be held in Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai and New Delhi, and interviews in Mumbai and / or New Delhi.
